title: Andrew & Tristan Tate, Facing Trafficking Case In Romania, Seen Partying At New York Fashion Week - NewsBreak
text:
By Baila Eve Zisman ,
7 hours ago Andrew Tate and his brother, Tristan, were seen at the Manhattan club Box during a New York Fa sh ion Week party being held by promoters Alessandro Brioschi and Matteo Garzia .
Both Tate and Tristan have been charged with human trafficking and rape and are under investigation in Romania.
According to an insider who spoke to Page Six , Tate and Tristan were seen at the Lower East Side venue with tequila at their table and they “left around 3:30 a.m. with a couple of pretty girls.”
A lawyer for the Tates declared, “Andrew and Tristan are surrounded by beautiful women everythwhere they go.”
The attorney added, regarding the alleged tequila at the brothers’ table, “Andrew never drinks. He is Muslim and has not had a drink since his reversion years ago.”
Last week “incel-ebrity” Clavicular was kicked out of the Standard Hotel’s famed club Le Bain after he refused to put away his cameras. He later got into a fight at another nightclub.
Subscribe To Our Cheat Sheet!One week of pop culture news in your inbox! Clavicular and the Tate brothers were seen together last month at a club in Miami where they asked the DJ to play Kanye West ‘s banned single ‘Heil Hitler’ and sang along.
Tate and Clavicular also more recently spent time together while both were in the city, as they streamed on the video platform Kick, talking about starting a fashion line called “Mogged by Clav.”
“It’s New York f—ing Fashion Week… we’re in f—ing New York. You walked for some other brand when you should be walking for your brand,” Tate told Clavicular at the time.
Tate added, “We have no time to wait for Dolce and Gabbana or f—ing Prada, or any of these f—-ts to get their act together. They’re all losers. I’m rich.”
The incel term “Mogging” originated from the manosphere acronym AMOG, Alpha Male of the Group. The term refers dominating someone else as part of the looksmaxxing trend, which focuses on outshining others in physical appearance or status.
